title: Clareon Home | KEY.co
description_expanded: Gather around the attractive dining table to enjoy a delicious home-cooked meal, or take your plates outside to the balcony for a memorable al-fresco dining experience, accompanied by the refreshing sea air. Restful nights await you in the three comfortably appointed bedrooms, each featuring its own TV. The primary bedroom even comes with the added convenience of an en-suite bath. Make use of the private washer/dryer to keep everyone's beachwear fresh and clean, while you utilize the complimentary WiFi to plan exciting outdoor adventures. The stunning floors and panoramic views of the gulf from both the living room and private balcony will take your breath away. Relax and unwind on the sumptuous furniture in the luxurious living room, where you can lose yourself in the pages of a favorite novel or enjoy a movie on the mounted flatscreen TV. The fully equipped kitchen boasts sleek stainless steel appliances, ample counter space, and a center prep island with two barstools, making meal preparation a breeze.

Features: Parking information- This unit has 2 parking spaces.
